name: scripttool
description: A library and command line program for working with fdx (Final Draft XML), osf, Fade In and Fountain formatted Screen Play files.
releaseNotes: Corrects the release text of v0.0.11, which said scripttool still required fdx v1.0.2 and osf v0.0.7: it requires fdx v1.0.4 and osf v0.0.9, so a Fountain scene number (INT. KITCHEN - DAY #12A#) becomes Final Draft's Number attribute in fountain2fdx and comes back in fdx2fountain. Requires fountain v1.0.3; the go directive is 1.26.4. A boneyard stays a visible paragraph in FDX and OSF, and OSF keeps no per-scene number. version.go, about.md, CITATION.cff and the installers are regenerated from codemeta.json for this release.
